messages:
Anya Patel: Heads-up — CI eval for model redwood-v2-int8 completed but the dashboard drilldown for 'per-sample errors' is empty. Run id 2026-03-18_9812.
Liam Chen: Which run id + panel?
Anya Patel: run=2026-03-18_9812, panel=Eval -> Errors -> Drilldown. Quick logs: 
```
runner: eval-runner v0.9.7
metrics: {"f1_micro": 0.72, "accuracy": 0.85}
```
ci-bot: CI pipeline #deploy-eval-9812: eval job completed with status: success (warnings).
Sahil Rao: Dashboard shows no rows when filter model_variant=int8. Sounds like an aggregation key mismatch or metrics key rename.
Morgan Blake: We renamed metric key f1_micro -> f1_micro_v2 in PR #432 last month — dashboard might still SELECT f1_micro.
Eva Morales: Also FYI the quantized runs tag sample_id under a different field in telemetry; last schema change moved sample.id -> sample_id. Could be that too.
Liam Chen: I can repro locally. Anya — can you paste a sample record from the run?
Anya Patel: sample snippet: 
```
{"sample_id": "s-1337", "model_variant": "redwood-v2-int8", "metrics": {"f1_micro_v2": 0.715}}
```
dashbot: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/xyz/eval-errors?panel=drilldown&model_variant=redwood-v2-int8
Anya Patel: If I filter by model_variant=int8 the drilldown table returns empty rows in the UI, but the API endpoint returns entries.
Sahil Rao: That implies the ETL wrote metric values under f1_micro_v2 but the dashboard query still expects f1_micro. Quick workaround: add metric_alias mapping in telemetry aggregation.
Morgan Blake: I'll add a fallback mapping in the aggregator: metric_aliases = {"f1_micro": ["f1_micro_v2", "f1_micro"]} and backfill last 7 days.
Anya Patel: Can we also add a CI regression test so eval-runner asserts dashboard keys exist after a run?
Liam Chen: Yep — I'll add a unit/integration test in eval-runner CI to simulate a quantized run and assert mapping presence. Will open a PR today.
Morgan Blake: I'll handle ETL change + backfill, then trigger staging deploy.
ci-bot: Scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-03-18T14:30Z for eval-telemetry.
Eva Morales: Also proposing to add a sample-level hash consistency check to detect field moves (sample_id vs sample.id).
Anya Patel: Thanks — please post PRs here and I'll re-run the failing eval after staging is up.
Liam Chen: PR #489 for test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/489
Morgan Blake: PR #490 for ETL mapping and backfill.
Anya Patel: Great :thumbsup: I'll re-run and report back.
Morgan Blake: Closing loop once backfill is done and staging passes.
ci-bot: Build logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7890
Anya Patel: Tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-223 — thanks everyone.
Eva Morales: :raised_hands:
